title: 3D reference turnaround
description: Orthographic front/side/back reference sheet for 3D modelling.

guidance: Ask for an orthographic turnaround: front, side and back views side by side on one compact landscape sheet (about 3:2, the requested size).
Each view fills most of the sheet height with small, even margins; never a long thin strip of small figures.
Same scale, same pose (A-pose or T-pose for characters) and aligned baselines in every view.
Plain light neutral background, flat lighting, no perspective.
avoid: long thin strip of small views

prompt_rubric: The prompt names one clear subject and its role in the game.
The prompt states the style, framing and background the purpose requires.
The prompt contains no text, logos, watermarks or real-world brands to render unless the purpose asks for them.
The prompt avoids contradictions (for example transparent background and a full scene).
The prompt fixes orthographic views, pose and scale consistency.
image_rubric: The image shows the subject the prompt asked for, without extra subjects.
The style matches the style preset; no mixed rendering styles.
No unwanted text, watermark, signature or frame.
No anatomical, perspective or structural errors that block the target use.
All requested views are present and consistent in proportions.
Views share scale and baseline; no perspective distortion.

constraints.lighting: Flat, even lighting with no cast shadows, rim light or dramatic key light.
